title: Fish support 🐟
body:
Hi!

I saw that Fish shell is currently not supported in Claude Code, with only Bash and Zsh being available.

Is there a roadmap or any plan to add Fish support in the future? If so, do you have an estimated timeline for its implementation?

Many developers use Fish for its powerful features, so it would be great to know if this is something that could be considered. 

Thanks in advance for your response!
author: katsenkatorz
